- [RCTS.1.2.36] **`compile_error`'s `also_raises`** ([RCTS.1.2.10]) — a
  non-empty list of codes, none repeated and none the fixture's `code`: what
  the program's one fault raises besides `code`. A `compile_error` fixture's
  program differs from a legal one by that one fault, so the codes it is
  refused with are exactly `code` and `also_raises`. A harness must fail the
  fixture if the compiler raises an error code the two do not name, or does not
  raise one they name. Warnings are not error codes. A harness must fail a fixture
  of any other `expect.kind` that carries the field, and one whose value is not
  such a list.
